'''David Kitzman''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2000 Olympia tournament]] on 1 April 2000 with Throne Room mains, no Nudj, according to Charles Hickey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d458">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-04-olympia-washington-4-1-00d458/ olympia-washington-4-1-00], DeckTech (Charles "Teacher" Hickey, 4 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-04-olympia-washington-4-1-00d458/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
